article.headline: Whaley leads UConn past Hartford 69-57
article.description: — James Bouknight scored 18 points and Isaiah Whaley had 10 points and 10 rebounds to lift UConn to a 69-57 win over Hartford on Friday night.
article.story: STORRS, Conn. -- — James Bouknight scored 18 points and Isaiah Whaley had 10 points and 10 rebounds to lift UConn to a 69-57 win over Hartford on Friday night. Jalen Gaffney added 15 points and R.J. Cole had 10 points for UConn (2-0). Tyrese Martin had six points and 10 rebounds. Moses Flowers had 24 points and seven rebounds for the Hawks (0-1).
